contract.trigger: Canonical Issue reads currently use unauthenticated GitHub REST and exhaust the shared IP quota; a real #39 treatment was interrupted.
contract.source: Session request: one physically evidenced GitHub App minimum-use atom, referencing noodles github ceremony at d4fa0da322cbb7a581328398906a4f04deaf0a69.
contract.owner: Soodles Issue provider reader; supervisor owns credential supply; existing Noodle and landing owners retain lifecycle/delivery.
changes: Add one authenticated Issue-read entry shared by Session CLI and automatic/supervised/worker consumers.
Consume an externally supplied installation token; never mint, rotate, discover another identity, or fall back to anonymous requests in the reader.
Reuse identity/URL-bound ETag bytes only after authenticated provider 304; retain quota headers and return bounded wait without retry.
Document the P-class shortest route and preserve scoped live App evidence.
behavior: Missing/invalid credentials fail before any unauthenticated request or admission effect; redirect refuses before token forwarding.
Fresh authenticated 200 or 304 supplies exact Issue JSON to the existing admission validator; reads do not authorize delivery.
Quota/reset state returns structured owner/required/next with exit 75; no stale-success result, alternate identity or retry loop.
defect_controls: Prove old anonymous-reader defect RED using the same no-anonymous control that passes GREEN after correction; legal authenticated read GREEN.
For cache identity/304, redirect, quota/no-retry gates retain planted-defect RED, corrected same control GREEN, and legitimate non-case GREEN.
Exercise real shared admission consumer with a restricted App token and capture HTTP status/rate headers/actual exit codes without secrets.
non_cases: Authenticated unchanged Issue returns server 304 and exact saved bytes; correct rejection is GREEN.
Provider failure/missing credential/quota wait preserves mailbox and does not spawn worker.
This atom does not recover the paused #39 stale Noodle proposal or rerun its comparison, does not guarantee global network blocking, and does not claim reduced Agent decision cost.
contract.acceptance: Focused discriminating controls plus supervisor-selected immutable external controls; canonical acceptance once for final clean candidate on lock-matching Linux carrier. Live macOS App evidence remains scoped separately.
contract.delivery: Existing externally selected landing owner only, exact-head successful provider CI and fresh supervisor admission before prepare/dispatch; transport exact emitted connector request, read back merge and Issue closure.
contract.reconciliation: Existing Noodle owner reconciles this atom worktree and local main before RESOLVED. Preserve #39 pending mailbox/worktree and any unknown writes.
contract.feature_scope: Authenticated Soodles Issue reader and P-class shortest entry; no new scheduler, retry engine, credential broker or provider policy flag.

next.reason: Obtain changed input/readback from the named owner before re-entering this boundary. Preserve existing identity and history; do not retry unchanged input. Worker entry remains Noodle-dispatched; help does not authorize another writer.
